title: International Sales Coordinator
description:
India Pack is a B2B packaging procurement firm based in Chinchwad, Pune. For about ten years we have sourced FIBCs (big bags), PP woven bags, BOPP bags, flexible pouches and container liners from 10+ audited Indian manufacturers, for buyers in the UK, Germany, Scandinavia, the USA and the Middle East. Our buyers rely on us for much more than a price. They expect us to watch every order from purchase order to delivery, keep factories on schedule, get documents right first time, and act quickly when something goes wrong after the goods arrive. We are hiring an After-Sales Support & Vendor Coordination Executive to own that work: following up with our partner factories, keeping international customers informed, handling complaints and claims, and making sure the terms we agree with buyers are the terms our suppliers deliver. 
 Role at a glance Title After-Sales Support & Vendor Coordination Executive Location India Pack office, Chinchwad, Pune (on-site) Type Full-time, permanent Reports to Managing Partner Experience 1 to 6 years in export coordination, customer support, vendor management or supply chain Working days Monday to Saturday; 2nd and 4th Saturdays off Key responsibilities 
 After-sales support Be the first point of contact for customers after an order is placed and after goods are delivered. Log, investigate and resolve complaints about quality, quantity, packing, labelling or documents. Gather evidence from the customer (photos, samples, test reports, batch numbers) and work with the factory to find the root cause and agree corrective action. Manage claims through to closure: replacement, credit note or rework, with clear records of what was agreed and why. Track recurring issues and report them so they are fixed at source. Coordination and follow-up Follow every open order against its production timeline: raw material, weaving, printing, stitching, inspection, packing and dispatch. Chase factories before deadlines, not after them, and flag any likely delay to the Managing Partner and the customer early. Coordinate pre-shipment inspections, samples, approvals and lab tests. Work with freight forwarders and CHAs on bookings, container loading and shipment tracking. Check export documents (invoice, packing list, certificates, bill of lading) before they reach the customer. Vendor management Manage day-to-day relationships with our partner manufacturers. Maintain supplier records: capabilities, certifications and their expiry dates, contacts and capacity. Score supplier performance on quality, on-time delivery, responsiveness and complaint history. Support supplier audits and onboarding of new factories. Contracts and order terms Check that each supplier purchase order matches the customer's order: specifications, quantities, prices, Incoterms, delivery dates, payment terms and labelling. Maintain a register of customer and supplier agreements, rate contracts and price validity, and flag renewals and expiries in advance. Track that agreed terms are actually met, and record any deviation and how it was resolved. International customer support Communicate with buyers in Europe, the UK, the USA and the Middle East by email and video call, clearly and professionally, in written English. Send proactive order updates so customers never have to chase us. Respond within agreed timelines, with attention to customer time zones. Keep all customer and supplier communication recorded in our helpdesk and Odoo ERP. Skills we are looking for Must have 1 to 3 years in export coordination, after-sales or customer support, vendor management, purchase or supply chain. Excellent written English. You will write to international buyers every day. A disciplined follow-up habit: you track every open item and close it without being reminded. Calm, clear handling of complaints, with the ability to stay firm with suppliers and courteous with customers. Attention to detail when checking specifications, documents and order terms. Comfort with Excel or Google Sheets for trackers and simple reports. A graduate degree in any discipline; commerce, engineering, textile or polymer technology preferred. Good to have Experience with export documentation, Incoterms and shipping processes. Knowledge of FIBCs, PP woven bags or industrial packaging. Experience with an ERP or helpdesk tool (Odoo, FreeScout, Zoho or similar). Experience handling quality claims or root-cause analysis (8D, CAPA). Exposure to contract or purchase order management. What success looks like Customers hear about delays from us first, never by chasing us. Complaints are acknowledged within one working day and closed within agreed timelines, with the root cause recorded. Fewer document errors and repeat complaints, quarter on quarter. Every open order, claim and contract renewal is visible on one up-to-date tracker. Factories see you as firm, fair and organised, and respond to you quickly. What we offer Hands-on exposure to international trade: buyers, factories, quality, logistics and documentation across several markets. Direct work with the Managing Partners in a small team where your work is visible. A competitive salary with performance and retention bonuses.

Key Skills: Operations,Purchase order,Processing,International,Export,Sales,Supply chain management,Purchase

title: Customer Support Associate -Email & Chat Support (Non-Voice)
description:
Job Description 
 Praxis Services is hiring enthusiastic and customer-focused graduates for an exciting opportunity in Email and Live Chat Customer Support (Non-Voice Process) for a reputed brand in India's Banking, Financial Services (BFSI) and E-commerce industry. 
 This is an excellent opportunity for freshers looking to start their careers in customer service, banking operations and digital commerce. The role involves handling customer queries and complaints exclusively through email and live chat. No voice process or calling is involved. 
 Complete paid training will be provided. Candidates with good written English communication, typing skills and basic computer knowledge are encouraged to apply. 
 Key Responsibilities Handle inbound customer queries and complaints through email and live chat. Assist customers with banking products, accounts, debit/credit cards, loans, EMIs and insurance. Resolve queries related to UPI, digital payments, failed transactions and disputed payments. Handle e-commerce queries related to order tracking, deliveries, cancellations, returns and refunds. Verify customer details in accordance with authentication and KYC guidelines. Provide accurate resolutions by following company SOPs and knowledge-base guidelines. Take ownership of customer cases and ensure timely resolution and follow-ups. Maintain accurate records of customer interactions in CRM/ticketing systems. Meet performance parameters such as SLA, TAT, CSAT, quality and AHT. Escalate unresolved or sensitive cases through the appropriate channels. Maintain confidentiality of customer information and transaction details. 
 Eligibility Criteria 
 Any Graduate can apply. Freshers and candidates with 01 year of experience are welcome. Final-year students awaiting results may also apply. Good written and spoken English communication skills. Versant Level 4 or equivalent English proficiency. Good typing speed and reading comprehension. Basic computer knowledge, including MS Office, email and web applications. Ability to multitask and manage multiple customer conversations. Comfortable working in rotational shifts and a 5.5-day work week. Willingness to undergo paid training and process assessments. Must be comfortable working from the office in Gurugram. 
 Why Join Praxis Services? 
 Freshers Welcome: No prior BPO or customer support experience required. Paid Training: Comprehensive induction and process training. No Calling: 100% non-voice process involving email and live chat. Attractive Compensation: Fixed monthly salary plus performance-based incentives. Additional Benefits: Two-way cab facility and medical insurance. Career Growth: Opportunities to progress to Senior Associate, Quality Analyst, Trainer and Team Leader positions. Big-Brand Exposure: Opportunity to work with a reputed brand in the BFSI and E-commerce sector. 
 Work Details Work Location: Gurugram (Work from Office). Work Schedule: 5.5 days working. Shifts: Rotational shifts. Employment: Full-Time, Permanent. Training: Fully paid training. Verification: Standard background and address verification applicable to BFSI processes. Interview Process Versant English Assessment HR Interview Operations Interview Final Selection Round 
 About Praxis Services 
 Praxis Services is a customer experience and business process management company founded in 2011 and headquartered in Gurugram. With approximately 800 employees across three delivery centres in Gurugram and Kolkata, we deliver customer experience solutions for leading brands across banking and financial services, aviation, hospitality, dining, private clubs and premium lifestyle services. We believe in developing talent through structured training, continuous learning and career advancement opportunities. Start your career with Praxis Services and grow with us! Interested candidates can apply now. Freshers are encouraged to apply.

Key Skills: Product support,Customer service,Bfsi,Customer experience,Voice process,Voice,Non voice,Customer experience management
